name: Midnight at the Pera Palace
description: At a historic Istanbul hotel, a journalist is unexpectedly thrust into the past and must stop a plot that could change the fate of modern Turkey.

videos.title: The Journey
videos.overview: While researching for an article on the Pera Palace, Esra stumbles into the year 1919, meets a doppelgänger and finds herself amid political intrigue.

videos.title: Roots
videos.overview: Stepping into Peride's shoes, Esra sets out with Ahmet to correct the course of history, but gets on Halit and George's radar.

videos.title: Secret
videos.overview: As the political stakes rise, Ahmet finds a notebook in the room occupied by Fahrettin, who informs Esra of George's sinister plan for Istanbul.

videos.title: Awol
videos.overview: Halit confronts Esra about her plans with Fahrettin. Esra slips a note to Mustafa Kemal, but her ruse puts others in jeopardy.

videos.title: What Goes Around Comes Around
videos.overview: Dimitri warns Ahmet about the perils of meddling with the past. As Leyla's fate hangs by a thread, Esra discovers Halit's true motives.

videos.title: Life or Death
videos.overview: With Ahmet's fate hinging on Halit's recovery, Esra uses Dimitri's key to travel in time and keeps encountering Halit under unexpected circumstances.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: A ring found near Peride's body sheds new light on the identity of her real killer. George makes a treacherous deal with Sonya and closes in on Halit.

videos.title: Hairspring
videos.overview: Sonya finds a key to changing the past. After confronting Reşat, Esra devises a plan to expose George's scheme and foil a wider conspiracy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: An unwelcome visitor arrives at present-day Pera Palace and Ahmet takes matters into his own hands. Esra begins her search for her biological mother.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Emotions run high as Esra is unexpectedly reunited with Halit in 1941, but suspicions arise as he reveals what he is truly capable of.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ahmet and Esra both find themselves taking on new jobs to open a few doors, while an old acquaintance of Halit jeopardizes the time passage.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An unlikely friendship forms between Esra and a new colleague. Now they must put their journalistic skills to work to uncover some shocking truths.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Trust between Esra and Halit continues to split at the seams when she discovers an incriminating letter in his coat pocket.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The search for Halime's baby takes Esra to another time, but this path leads her right into harm's way. Will she be able to dance her way out of it?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Esra returns to 1941 to find that she has been gone far longer than expected. Ahmet's mind spirals into a deteriorated state.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: After Esra discovers an important connection among the captured women, she devises a plot to take down Mümtaz's diabolical schemes once and for all.
